papers.title_en: AI-driven medical image analysis for sports injury diagnosis and prevention
papers.title_zh: AI驱动的医学图像分析用于运动损伤诊断与预防
papers.tldr_en: An AI-driven framework integrating deep learning, biomechanical modeling, and adaptive decision-making for injury prediction and rehabilitation optimization is proposed, paving the way for more accurate, interpretable, and responsive injury management systems.
papers.abstract_en: Sports-related injuries present significant challenges in diagnosis, prevention, and rehabilitation, often requiring precise assessments across multiple imaging modalities. Traditional diagnostic approaches rely on manual interpretation, which is time-consuming and prone to variability. To address these limitations, we propose an AI-driven framework integrating deep learning, biomechanical modeling, and adaptive decision-making for injury prediction and rehabilitation optimization. The Biomechanically-Informed Neural Network (BINN) fuses kinematic, physiological, and performance data using attention mechanisms, enhancing both interpretability and predictive accuracy. BINN processes motion capture data through convolutional and recurrent layers, extracting meaningful biomechanical patterns to assess movement efficiency and injury risk. papers.abstract_zh: 运动损伤在诊断、预防和康复方面提出了重大挑战，通常需要对多种成像模式进行精确评估。传统的诊断方法依赖于人工判读，这既耗时又容易出现变异性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个AI驱动的框架，该框架整合了深度学习、生物力学建模和自适应决策，用于损伤预测和康复优化。生物力学信息神经网络（BINN）利用注意力机制融合了运动学、生理学和表现数据。

papers.title_en: Deciphering Muscular Dynamics: A Dual-Attention Framework for Predicting Muscle Contraction From Activation Patterns
papers.title_zh: 解读肌肉动力学：一种基于双注意力机制的框架，用于从激活模式预测肌肉收缩
papers.journal: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
papers.journal_tier: 计算机：信息系统1区/数学与计算生物学1区/医学：信息1区/计算机：跨学科应用2区 TOP
papers.abstract_en: Quantitatively deciphering the relationship between muscle activation and thickness deformation is essential for diagnosing muscle-related diseases and monitoring muscle health (e.g., Facioscapulohumeral Dystrophy). Despite the potential of ultrasound (US) imaging and sensing to measure changes in muscle thickness during movements, it remains challenging to make a fully portable device, considering the wiring and data collection. On the other hand, surface electromyography (sEMG) can record muscle bioelectrical signals and measure muscle activations, offering a unique perspective that correlates with underlying changes in muscle thickness. This paper introduces a deep-learning-based approach that used sEMG signals to infer muscle deformation. Using a hierarchical combination of self-attention and cross-attention mechanisms, this method predicted muscle deformation directly from sEMG data
papers.abstract_zh: 定量解读肌肉激活与厚度变形之间的关系，对于诊断肌肉相关疾病和监测肌肉健康（例如，面肩肱型肌营养不良症）至关重要。尽管超声（US）成像和传感有潜力测量运动过程中肌肉厚度的变化，但考虑到布线和数据采集，制造一个完全便携式设备仍然具有挑战性。另一方面，表面肌电图（sEMG）可以记录肌肉生物电信号并测量肌肉激活，提供了一个与肌肉功能相关的独特视角。

papers.title_en: Muscle synergy characteristics of pumping in Chinese elite windsurfers
papers.title_zh: 中国精英帆板运动员推舵动作的肌肉协同特征
papers.tldr_en: It is revealed that elite windsurfers employ four consistent muscle synergies during pumping, with phase-specific lateral asymmetries in muscle contributions and a stable activation hierarchy.
papers.abstract_en: The functional roles of different muscle synergies can be defined through their correlation with biomechanical parameters, making this approach widely applicable in sports science. Muscle synergy analysis has demonstrated unique value in developing specialized skill training. This study aimed to investigate muscle synergy characteristics during pumping in elite windsurfers. Eight elite athletes were recruited to perform 30-s on-shore pumping trials on a windsurfing simulator. Muscle activity was recorded using a 16-channel wireless surface electromyography system (Myon, Cometa, Italy). Non-negative matrix factorization was applied to extract muscle synergy contributions and activation patterns across two pumping phases. papers.abstract_zh: 不同肌肉协同的功能作用可以通过其与生物力学参数的相关性来定义，这使得该方法在运动科学中具有广泛的适用性。肌肉协同分析在发展专业技能训练方面显示出独特的价值。本研究旨在调查精英帆板运动员在推舵动作期间的肌肉协同特征。招募了八名精英运动员，在帆板模拟器上进行30秒的陆上推舵试验。肌肉活动使用16通道无线表面肌电图系统（Myon, Cometa, Italy）进行记录。采用非负矩阵分解（NMF）方法提取肌肉协同。

papers.title_en: Chronic Pain Severity Modifies Gait Biomechanics and Muscle Activation in Individuals with Chronic Ankle Instability.
papers.title_zh: 慢性疼痛严重程度改变慢性踝关节不稳个体步态生物力学和肌肉激活
papers.tldr_en: Individuals with CAI who report greater pain severity demonstrate distinct, time-specific gait deviations and greater neuromuscular inhibition, which may extend beyond the effects of instability alone.
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
To investigate differences in neuromechanics during walking between individuals with chronic ankle instability (CAI) reporting high and low chronic pain, and healthy controls, with a focus on stance-phase joint kinematics and muscle activation patterns.


METHODS
Sixty physically active participants were classified into three groups: CAI with high pain (n=20), CAI with low pain (n=20), and controls (n=20). Pain severity was determined using the Foot and Ankle Outcome Score pain subscale. Three-dimensional lower extremity kinematics and surface electromyography activation of six lower extremity muscles were recorded during overground walking at self-selected speed. Functional data analysis was used to identify stance-phase differences between groups.

papers.title_en: Effects of unilateral and bilateral eccentric training on lower limb maximal strength, jump, and sprint performance in trained adolescent male basketball players: a randomized controlled trial
papers.title_zh: 单侧与双侧离心训练对受训青少年男性篮球运动员下肢最大力量、跳跃和冲刺表现的影响：一项随机对照试验
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Although both UET and BET interventions demonstrated within-group potential to improve specific sports performance metrics in trained adolescent basketball players, neither modality established a statistically significant absolute between-group advantage.
papers.abstract_en: Basketball requires a solid foundation of lower limb strength and explosive power. Unilateral and bilateral resistance training modes may differ in improving sport-specific performance, but their relative effects and potential advantages in trained adolescent athletes remain unclear. This pilot study aims to explore the application effects of these two methods on specific performance indicators. This exploratory study aimed to compare the effects of a seven-week unilateral eccentric training (UET) and bilateral eccentric training (BET) on lower limb maximal strength, jump, and sprint performance in trained adolescent male basketball players. Twelve participants (n=12) were randomly assigned to either a UET or BET group. papers.abstract_zh: 篮球运动需要扎实的下肢力量和爆发力基础。单侧和双侧抗阻训练模式在提高专项运动表现方面可能存在差异，但它们在受训青少年运动员中的相对效果和潜在优势尚不明确。这项初步研究旨在探讨这两种方法对特定表现指标的应用效果。这项探索性研究旨在比较为期七周的单侧离心训练（UET）和双侧离心训练（BET）对下肢最大力量、跳跃和冲刺表现的影响。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：离心抗阻训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：离心抗阻训练被认为是增强成人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚未得到充分理解。目的：本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心抗阻训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）的影响。方法：从电子检索工具中检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章。
